title: NomicLaw: Emergent Trust and Strategic Argumentation in LLMs During Collaborative Law-Making

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Self-Vote Rate (SVR) to quantify an LLM agent's tendency to vote for its own legislative proposals rather than engaging with or supporting peers' proposals.

Comparing interaction metrics like coalition switch rates, vote volatility, and edge density between homogeneous (same-model) and heterogeneous (multi-model) groups to observe insular agreement and lack of diverse deliberation.

Using a hybrid LLM-human thematic analysis to code justifications and identify if agents disproportionately favor specific legal-philosophical themes (e.g., Justice, Legality) while ignoring others (e.g., Utility, Autonomy).
